create_evolution_pool: create an EvolutionPool instance with a seed, ES parameters, and tensor sizes dictionary
populate_children: populate child individuals in the evolution pool by mutating parent tensors with Gaussian noise
apply_global_reward: apply normalized rewards to parent tensors and update gradients using the Adam optimizer
compute_all_local_rewards: compute and return a tensor of local rewards for all individuals in the population
create_onemax_evolution_pool: create a OneMaxEvolutionPool that rewards tensors approaching alternating positive and negative infinity
